situation (example wording): "Which large US city had the highest violent crime rate in 2023?"
what the app does today: Answered by whichever tab is open. Current Trends covers about 700 agencies; NIBRS its reporters; Historical (FBI annual data) the most.
proposed behavior: "Large" or "big" city means a population of 250,000 or more, stated in the answer. The source follows P01 (completed years: Historical; the current year: Current Trends, naming its sample).
exact default or choices offered: "Large" or "big" city: a population of 250,000 or more.
why: The cutoff decides which cities are compared, so it has one fixed meaning, named in the answer.
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-historical.ts, scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts.
